OMNI — Definition: of all things.

Pickleball is a battle of strategy between you and your opponent. A game of aggressive attacks and defensive resets. Whether you’re making your move or trying to get back to neutral, you need a paddle that can help you work the point and win the rally. A paddle that can do it all.

The Selkirk OMNI™ redefines an all-court paddle for the modern fast-paced game.

Power. Control. Spin. Durability. This foam paddle has versatile performance to support your game.

React. Adapt. Win.

With the Selkirk OMNI, you really can have it all.

ReactCore™ for Control When You Need It and Power When You Want It.

The ReactCore consists of a PureFoam™ floating center with a new PureFoam™ Ring surrounded by an EVA Power Ring for a dynamic core with adaptive flexibility. This double-ring technology takes the EVA Power Ring players loved in Project Boomstik and refines it with an additional PureFoam Ring for a more connected feel with additional control. This gives you consistent playability across your paddle face with versatile all-court performance for the modern fast-paced game. You'll have great power, a plush feeling on control shots, and dwell to grab the ball for more spin.

(New!) Adjustable MOI Tuning System for Maximum Sweet Spot and Balance, With the Ability to Customize.

Your paddle includes Selkirk’s MOI Tuning System, meaning it’s already precisely weighted for a maximum sweet spot and stabilized balance — helping you get more balls over the net. While this works for the vast majority of players, this next generation of the MOI Tuning System gives you the ability to remove and rearrange the perimeter weights by hand to fine-tune your paddle. The MOI weights are designed to hold steady and will not shift during play. 

See a step-by-step guide to customizing your MOI weights here. Looking to reapply the weights as they came, for an optimized sweet spot? Use the reference marks on your paddle face as a guide.

Tournament-Legal InfiniGrit® Surface for 3x Spin Durability Over Raw Carbon. 

The InfiniGrit® Surface delivers tournament-legal, long-lasting spin engineered to max out strict USAP compliance standards. While some non-compliant paddles risk being banned from amateur leagues and tournaments, InfiniGrit® ensures you stay legal with elite spin potential up to 2,000 RPMs. Built for ultimate durability, it lasts 3x longer than traditional embossed epoxy peel-ply texture raw carbon surfaces — giving you a lasting competitive edge in the matches that matter most.

Multistrata Face for Balanced Performance.

A proprietary, patent-pending multi-layer T700 carbon-fiber system tunable for balanced performance and engineered to integrate seamlessly with PureFoam™ technology. Together, they deliver optimized flexibility, consistent energy return, and rock-solid durability.

Octagonal Handle for Better Control.

The upgraded octagonal grip offers greater maneuverability and shot accuracy on the court.

See Selkirk’s Paddle Care Guide.

Country of Origin: Made in China

Limited Lifetime Warranty

Selkirk Sport pickleball paddles are guaranteed against workmanship and manufacturer defects for the lifetime of the paddle with activation of warranty through the registering of the paddle with Selkirk Sport. The warranty is not transferable after registration and only applies to the original owner.

Tesla Paddles are backed by a dedicated 1-year limited warranty.

What's Covered and What's Not

Manufacturing defects in materials and workmanship are covered for the lifetime of the product. Normal wear and tear, damage caused by abuse, negligence/user modification, chips to the top or sides of edgeless paddles, and the natural breakdown or fading of graphics or textures over extended use are not covered.

Miscellaneous

This warranty is available for Selkirk Sport pickleball paddles in the United States. Selkirk Sport holds the sole discretion to determine whether a damaged paddle is covered under our lifetime warranty. Selkirk Sport has the sole discretion to determine whether to replace or repair a paddle covered under our limited lifetime warranty. Replacement paddles are not covered under our limited lifetime warranty.

FREE SHIPPING AND RETURNS ON US ORDERS OVER $55

How long will it take to receive my order?
Orders are processed within 1-2 business days. Standard shipping via FedEx Ground takes approximately 5-7 days for delivery. For expedited shipping, there's a 1-2 business day processing time before orders ship. Orders placed over the weekend will ship the following Tuesday. Please note that during product launches, high-volume periods, and holidays, processing and shipping times are not guaranteed and will likely be extended due to increased order volume.

What are my options for expedited shipping?
To optimize the customer experience according to individual needs, we offer expedited shipping through various carriers, selectable at checkout. Estimated shipping times, provided by carriers, are not guaranteed, and consequently, we cannot refund shipping charges if orders do not arrive within the estimated timeframe.
It's important to note that expedited shipping does not bypass the standard processing time required to ship an order. Please be aware that FedEx Express services, such as FedEx 2-day and FedEx Overnight, do not deliver on weekends or holidays.

US Return Policy
We want you to love your paddle! We offer a 30-day hassle-free return/exchange policy. Simply buy the paddle you're interested in, play with it for 30 days. If it doesn't work for your game, return it for a full refund or exchange it for a different one. Plus, Selkirk covers standard shipping both ways. We’ve taken the risk out of purchasing a new paddle.

International Return Policy
We want our international (outside the US) customers to love their paddle as well! We offer the same 30-day hassle-free return/exchange policy with the exception of the free shipping. Simply buy the paddle you're interested in, play with it for 30 days. If it doesn't work for your game, return it for a full refund or exchange it for a different one. Selkirk is more than happy to extend this offer, however we are not able to cover the associated shipping costs for international orders.

*Clear signs of abuse would disqualify products from being eligible for return. Evidence of play, however, is not considered abuse, so feel free to play away!

Customers say this paddle delivers an excellent balance of power and control. Many appreciate the adjustable weights feature, which allows them to customize the paddle for their specific game style. Users frequently mention improved shot-making, particularly with drops and dinking, and praise the large sweet spot and responsive feel. The spin and pop off the paddle are commonly highlighted as standout qualities. Most players note quick adjustment periods and report noticeable game improvements. A few mention the grip can slip when sweaty, and one customer wished for a shorter handle. Overall, reviewers consistently recommend this paddle as versatile and well-made.
